purpose: Source-derived original H1 completion criteria aligned with Fudan motion-transfer boundary for forthcoming declared frozen test

original_predicates.on_top: (wheel_N > c.support_N).all(-1) & wheel_contact_platform.all(-1) & wheel_footprints_inside_top.all(-1) & (wheel_bottom_world_z >= c.platform_top_m - c.geometry_skin_m).all(-1) & nonwheel_clean
original_predicates.stable: self.landed & on_top & (root_vz.abs() <= c.stable_speed_m_s) & (planar_speed <= c.stable_speed_m_s) & (roll.abs() < c.stable_tilt_rad) & (pitch.abs() < c.stable_tilt_rad) & (yaw.abs() < c.stable_yaw_rad)

Fudan_transfer_scope: Standing-jump ascent/tuck/orientation experience is converted to own geometry; forward arrival and platform landing/recovery are MOD4 task additions, not foreign joint/torque/dynamics ground truth
acceptance: Actual original takeoff, dual-wheel edge-clear/height, full authored wheel footprints inside top, real support/platform contact, original landing12 and stable200 callbacks; full original end-to-end attempt saved
source_reset_scope: Freeze must capture original physical callback caches and events before auto-reset; FINAL current episode and short retained fragments are not whole-window totals
original_source_discovery_note: Initial broad full-path filename filter matched H1 parent directory and truncated; corrected basename-only/text search, no source mutation or training effect
